title: 第22章 先知改第23章 先知二改
content_zh:
“保重。”作家挥了挥手直接进入法师塔，门随即关上。白凌看着渐渐消的大门，心里有些小小的不一样的滋味。
正当白凌准备有些小失落地转身离去，一道轻微的门扉开启声在静谧的空气中回荡，引起了她的注意。她迅速回过身，只见作家正笑盈盈地望着她，眼神中闪烁着邀请的光芒。他轻声问道：“白凌，你是否有兴趣探索一个异世界的奥秘？也许，这次我们还能邀请上你那位青梅竹马的伙伴，一同踏上这奇幻的旅程。”
“你这，莫非便是那盛情满满的正式邀请？“白凌的双眼在话语间笑得更像是弯弯的月牙，恍若璀璨的星辰藏匿其中，闪烁着愉悦的光芒。
“当然，我视友情如珍宝，对于我的朋友们，我向来都是慷慨大方的。“
没过多久时间，当白凌与王健强一齐来到这里，王健强凝视着眼前那扇神秘的门扉，眼中闪烁着好奇与期待，轻声问道：“这，便是你口中的那扇任意门吗？”
“什么任意门，这是作家的法师塔入口。”白凌纠正王健强的说法。
“听你说的这门很像动漫里哪都可以去的任意门。”
“来，站门外干嘛，进来。”门扉缓缓由内开启，作家热情地向他们招手，脸上洋溢着诚挚的笑容，邀请他们踏入这个神奇的空间。
“哇～！“王健强首次踏入法师塔，四周弥漫的魔幻氛围与宽敞的空间让他瞠目结舌，心灵被强烈的震撼所触动。
“有想去什么样的地方吗？”作家优雅地落座于他的专属书桌前，双手轻轻一挥，仿佛无数绚烂的世界便在四周翩翩起舞，环绕在他的周围。
“我渴望踏上那片蔚蓝的海岸，或是隐匿于碧波万顷中的神秘海岛！最好是那种鲜为人知，却拥有着如梦如幻般神奇景色的地方。“白凌倾吐着内心的向往。
“如此，海岛、海岸，还有那令人神往的神奇景色……好吧，现在，就让我们借助法师塔的力量，寻找那个符合我们心意的世界吧！“话语落下，无数的世界开始在书桌周围旋转，伴随着法师塔的轻微颤动，它们缓缓收入其中，直至一切恢复平静。
在广袤无垠的大海深处，有一座孑然独立的小岛，恰似一颗璀璨明珠，悄然镶嵌于碧波浩渺的海面之上。海浪一波又一波地拍击着岛屿的岩岸，溅起层层洁白的浪花，沙滩则呈现出别样的静谧与美丽。
然而，这份宁静未能长久持续。沙滩上赫然出现一扇神秘的大门，静静地矗立在那里，门突然被打开，作家向外探头张望了一番，随后将其完全敞开。
“这正是你们所期盼的，海岛，还有沙滩。”作家轻轻侧身，优雅地做出一个“请”的手势。白凌与王健强毫不犹豫，依次迈出门外，踏上了他们梦寐以求的度假探险之旅。
“真的是大海和海岛，太美了！”白凌站在柔软的沙滩上，任由海风轻柔拂过，尽情享受着这难得的宁静时光，心灵在这片壮丽的海景中得到了深深的慰藉。
“我能在这里游泳吗？”王健强活动着四肢，做着拉伸动作。
“先等我看看水里是否安全……还好，没有什么特别的。”作家来到海水边，慎重地伸出手，试探性地触摸着清凉的海水。经过好一会儿的仔细检查，他才缓缓站起身来，脸上露出安心的微笑。
“你们看！岛那边有个很高的建筑！”众人顺着白凌手指的方向望去，只见海岛的远端矗立着一座高耸的建筑，其形状宛如古老的金字塔，神秘而庄重。在阳光的照射下，那座建筑的轮廓清晰可见，然而它的色彩呈现出一种淡淡的黑色，仿佛是历经岁月洗礼的古老遗迹，散发出深邃而迷人的气息。
作家以他特有的随意口吻说道：“若是有时间，我们倒是可以进去探索一番。”他的语气中透露出一种从容与淡定，仿佛早已见惯世间的千奇百怪。只是那座金字塔般的建筑物，虽然从远处望去只是浅黑色的一片，却已足够引起另外两人的好奇。

“让我们成为首批在其他世界中畅游的地球人吧！”王健强热情洋溢地欢呼着，毫不犹豫地脱下衣物，露出健康的小麦色肌肤。他像矫健的鱼儿一般，猛然跃入那片湛蓝的海水里，几个有力的扑腾之后，已然游向了遥远的地方。
“哇！太赞了！这海水的味道并非浓烈的咸涩，反而透着一股淡淡的清新。而且，越往深处游去，海水似乎愈发显得粘稠，仿佛拥有了一种神奇的质感。快，你们也下来感受一下吧！”王健强在海水中兴奋地呼唤着两人，他的声音充满了对这片神奇海域的惊叹。
“等我去换一下泳装！”白凌也伸手触摸了海水，感受着那适宜的温度，接着向两人点了点头，随后转身朝着法师塔大门的方向走去。
在不远处，三艘外形如同鱼一般的船只靠岸停下。随着船只的靠近，几名身着黑衣的人从船舱中走出，他们彼此默契地对视一眼，接着迅速而有序地分散开来，悄然无声地融入到岛屿的深处。
法师塔的门紧紧关闭着，仿佛一道坚固的屏障，将外界的一切纷扰隔绝在外。这扇神秘之门，只向那三位被命运选中的旅行者敞开。这时，一只陌生的手搭在了门把手上，尝试用力扭动，然而无论怎样努力，门都毫无反应。几次尝试无果后，那只手的主人果断地放弃了，转身离开。
没多久门被打开，白凌披着毛巾，身着性感的泳衣，将她玲珑有致的身段尽显无遗。没走出几步，她却发现脚下有一双陌生的脚印出现在门口，那脚印湿漉漉的，显然是刚刚离开不久。它们蜿蜒向前，径直指向远处那座神秘的黑色建筑。白凌的好奇心被彻底点燃，她顺着那串湿漉漉的脚印跟了过去。
content_en:
"Take care." The writer waved his hand and entered the mage tower directly, and the door was closed immediately. Bai Ling looked at the closing door, feeling a little different in his heart.
Just as Bai Ling was about to turn around and leave with a little disappointment, a slight sound of the door opening echoed in the quiet air, catching her attention. She turned around quickly and saw the writer looking at her with a smile, his eyes shining with invitation. He asked softly: "Bai Ling, are you interested in exploring the mysteries of a different world? Maybe, this time we can invite your childhood sweetheart to embark on this fantastic journey together."
"Is this the formal invitation full of warmth?" Bai Ling's eyes smiled more like crescent moons as he spoke, as if the bright stars were hidden in them, shining with joyful light.
"Of course, I value friendship as a treasure, and I have always been generous to my friends."
Not long after, when Bai Ling and Wang Jianqiang arrived together, Wang Jianqiang stared at the mysterious door in front of him, with curiosity and expectation in his eyes, and asked softly: "Is this the arbitrary door you mentioned?"
"What is the arbitrary door? This is the entrance to the writer's mage tower." Bai Ling corrected Wang Jianqiang's statement.
"The door you said is very similar to any door in the anime where you can go anywhere."
"Come on, why are you standing outside the door? Come in." The door slowly opened from the inside, and the writer waved to them enthusiastically, with a sincere smile on his face, inviting them to step into this magical space.
"Wow~!" Wang Jianqiang stepped into the Mage Tower for the first time. The magical atmosphere and spacious space surrounding him made him stunned, and his soul was touched by a strong shock.
"Do you want to go somewhere?" The writer sat elegantly in front of his exclusive desk. He waved his hands lightly, as if countless gorgeous worlds were dancing around him.
"I long to set foot on that azure coast, or the mysterious island hidden in the vast expanse of blue waves! It is best to be a place that is little known but has dreamlike and magical scenery." Bai Ling poured out his inner yearning.
"So, the islands, the coast, and the fascinating magical scenery... Okay, now, let us use the power of the Mage Tower to find the world that suits our hearts!" As the words fell, countless worlds began to rotate around the desk, and with the slight trembling of the Mage Tower, they were slowly included in it until everything returned to calm.
In the depths of the vast sea, there is a lonely island, just like a bright pearl, quietly embedded in the vast blue sea. The waves hit the rocky shore of the island one after another, splashing layers of white spray, while the beach presents a different kind of tranquility and beauty.
However, this tranquility could not last long. A mysterious door suddenly appeared on the beach, standing there quietly. The door was suddenly opened. The writer looked outside for a while, and then opened it completely.
"This is exactly what you have been looking forward to, the island and the beach." The writer gently turned sideways and gracefully made a "please" gesture. Without hesitation, Bai Ling and Wang Jianqiang stepped out one after another and embarked on the vacation adventure they had dreamed of.
"It's really the sea and the island, so beautiful!" Bai Ling stood on the soft beach, letting the sea breeze blow gently, enjoying this rare quiet time, and her soul was deeply comforted by this magnificent sea view.
"Can I swim here?" Wang Jianqiang moved his limbs and stretched.
"Let me see if the water is safe first... Fortunately, there is nothing special." The writer came to the seaside, cautiously stretched out his hand, and tentatively touched the cool seawater. After a while of careful inspection, he slowly stood up with a reassuring smile on his face.
"Look! There is a very tall building on the other side of the island!"People looked in the direction of Bai Ling's finger and saw a towering building standing on the far end of the island. Its shape was like an ancient pyramid, mysterious and solemn. Under the sunlight, the outline of the building is clearly visible, but its color shows a faint black color, as if it is an ancient relic that has gone through the baptism of time, exuding a deep and charming atmosphere.
The writer said in his unique casual tone: "If we have time, we can go in and explore." His tone revealed a calmness and calmness, as if he had already seen all kinds of strange things in the world. It's just that the pyramid-like building, although it is just a light black piece when viewed from a distance, is enough to arouse the curiosity of the other two people.
"Let us be the first people on earth to swim in other worlds!" Wang Jianqiang cheered enthusiastically, taking off his clothes without hesitation, revealing his healthy wheat-colored skin. Like a vigorous fish, he suddenly jumped into the blue water, and after a few powerful splashes, he was already swimming to a distant place.
"Wow! It's amazing! The taste of the seawater is not strong and salty, but has a light freshness. Moreover, the deeper you swim, the more viscous the seawater seems to be, as if it has a magical texture. Come on, come down and feel it!" Wang Jianqiang called to the two of them excitedly in the seawater, his voice full of wonder at this magical sea.
"Wait while I go change into my swimsuit!" Bai Ling also reached out and touched the sea water, feeling the suitable temperature. Then he nodded to the two of them, then turned and walked towards the gate of the Mage Tower.
Not far away, three fish-like boats docked at the shore. As the ship approached, several people dressed in black walked out of the cabin. They looked at each other in tacit understanding, then dispersed quickly and orderly, quietly blending into the depths of the island.
The door of the mage tower is tightly closed, like a solid barrier, isolating all the disturbances from the outside world. This mysterious door is only open to the three travelers chosen by fate. At this time, a strange hand placed on the door handle and tried to twist it, but no matter how hard it tried, the door did not respond. After several unsuccessful attempts, the owner of the hand gave up decisively and turned around to leave.
Not long after, the door was opened, and Bai Ling was wearing a towel and a sexy swimsuit, showing off her exquisite figure. After taking a few steps, she found a pair of unfamiliar footprints appearing at the door. The footprints were wet, and it was obvious that they had just left. They meander forward, pointing directly at the mysterious black building in the distance. Bai Ling's curiosity was completely ignited, and she followed the series of wet footprints.
